versos.hebraico: לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ עַל־אַיֶּ֥לֶת הַשַּׁ֗חַר מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃
אֵלִ֣י אֵ֭לִי לָמָ֣ה עֲזַבְתָּ֑נִי רָח֥וֹק מִֽ֝ישׁוּעָתִ֗י דִּבְרֵ֥י שַׁאֲגָתִֽי׃

controles.web: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?
controles.kjv: My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? why art thou so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring?
controles.livre: Deus meu, Deus meu, por que me desamparaste? Longe estás de meu livramento e das palavras de meu gemido.

versos.hebraico: אֱֽלֹהַ֗י אֶקְרָ֣א י֭וֹמָם וְלֹ֣א תַעֲנֶ֑ה וְ֝לַ֗יְלָה וְֽלֹא־דֽוּמִיָּ֥ה לִֽי׃

controles.web: My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.
controles.kjv: O my God, I cry in the daytime, but thou hearest not; and in the night season, and am not silent.
controles.livre: Deus meu, eu clamo de dia, e tu não me respondes; também clamo de noite, e não tenho sossego.

versos.hebraico: וְאַתָּ֥ה קָד֑וֹשׁ י֝וֹשֵׁ֗ב תְּהִלּ֥וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: But you are holy, you who inhabit the praises of Israel.
controles.kjv: But thou art holy, O thou that inhabitest the praises of Israel.
controles.livre: Porém tu és Santo, que habitas nos louvores de Israel.

versos.hebraico: בְּ֭ךָ בָּטְח֣וּ אֲבֹתֵ֑ינוּ בָּ֝טְח֗וּ וַֽתְּפַלְּטֵֽמוֹ׃

controles.web: Our fathers trusted in you. They trusted, and you delivered them.
controles.kjv: Our fathers trusted in thee: they trusted, and thou didst deliver them.
controles.livre: Nossos pais confiaram em ti; eles confiaram, e tu os livraste.

versos.hebraico: אֵלֶ֣יךָ זָעֲק֣וּ וְנִמְלָ֑טוּ בְּךָ֖ בָטְח֣וּ וְלֹא־בֽוֹשׁוּ׃

controles.web: They cried to you, and were delivered. They trusted in you, and were not disappointed.
controles.kjv: They cried unto thee, and were delivered: they trusted in thee, and were not confounded.
controles.livre: Eles clamaram a ti, e escaparam do perigo ; eles confiaram em ti, e não foram envergonhados.

versos.hebraico: וְאָנֹכִ֣י תוֹלַ֣עַת וְלֹא־אִ֑ישׁ חֶרְפַּ֥ת אָ֝דָ֗ם וּבְז֥וּי עָֽם׃

controles.web: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised by the people.
controles.kjv: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.
controles.livre: Mas eu sou um verme, e não um homem; sou humilhado pelos homens, e desprezado pelo povo.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־רֹ֭אַי יַלְעִ֣גוּ לִ֑י יַפְטִ֥ירוּ בְ֝שָׂפָ֗ה יָנִ֥יעוּ רֹֽאשׁ׃

controles.web: All those who see me mock me. They insult me with their lips. They shake their heads, saying,
controles.kjv: All they that see me laugh me to scorn: they shoot out the lip, they shake the head, saying,
controles.livre: Todos os que me veem zombam de mim; abrem os lábios e sacodem a cabeça, dizendo :

versos.hebraico: גֹּ֣ל אֶל־יְהוָ֣ה יְפַלְּטֵ֑הוּ יַ֝צִּילֵ֗הוּ כִּ֘י חָ֥פֵֽץ בּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: “He trusts in Yahweh; let him deliver him. Let him rescue him, since he delights in him.”
controles.kjv: He trusted on the Lord that he would deliver him: let him deliver him, seeing he delighted in him.
controles.livre: Ele confiou no “SENHOR”; agora que ele o salve e o liberte; pois se agrada nele.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֣ה גֹחִ֣י מִבָּ֑טֶן מַ֝בְטִיחִ֗י עַל־שְׁדֵ֥י אִמִּֽי׃

controles.web: But you brought me out of the womb. You made me trust at my mother’s breasts.
controles.kjv: But thou art he that took me out of the womb: thou didst make me hope when I was upon my mother’s breasts.
controles.livre: Tu és o que me tiraste do ventre; e o que me deu segurança, estando eu junto aos seios de minha mãe.

versos.hebraico: עָ֭לֶיךָ הָשְׁלַ֣כְתִּי מֵרָ֑חֶם מִבֶּ֥טֶן אִ֝מִּ֗י אֵ֣לִי אָֽתָּה׃

controles.web: I was thrown on you from my mother’s womb. You are my God since my mother bore me.
controles.kjv: I was cast upon thee from the womb: thou art my God from my mother’s belly.
controles.livre: Eu fui lançado sobre ti desde que saí d o útero; desde o ventre de minha mãe tu és meu Deus.

versos.hebraico: אַל־תִּרְחַ֣ק מִ֭מֶּנִּי כִּי־צָרָ֣ה קְרוֹבָ֑ה כִּי־אֵ֥ין עוֹזֵֽר׃

controles.web: Don’t be far from me, for trouble is near. For there is no one to help.
controles.kjv: Be not far from me; for trouble is near; for there is none to help.
controles.livre: Não fiques longe de mim, porque a minha angústia está perto; pois não há quem me ajude.

versos.hebraico: סְ֭בָבוּנִי פָּרִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים אַבִּירֵ֖י בָשָׁ֣ן כִּתְּרֽוּנִי׃

controles.web: Many bulls have surrounded me. Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me.
controles.kjv: Many bulls have compassed me: strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.
controles.livre: Muitos touros me cercaram; fortes de Basã me rodearam.

versos.hebraico: פָּצ֣וּ עָלַ֣י פִּיהֶ֑ם אַ֝רְיֵ֗ה טֹרֵ֥ף וְשֹׁאֵֽג׃

controles.web: They open their mouths wide against me, lions tearing prey and roaring.
controles.kjv: They gaped upon me with their mouths, as a ravening and a roaring lion.
controles.livre: Abriram contra mim suas bocas, como leão que despedaça e ruge.

versos.hebraico: כַּמַּ֥יִם נִשְׁפַּכְתִּי֮ וְהִתְפָּֽרְד֗וּ כָּֽל־עַצְמ֫וֹתָ֥י הָיָ֣ה לִ֭בִּי כַּדּוֹנָ֑ג נָ֝מֵ֗ס בְּת֣וֹךְ מֵעָֽי׃

controles.web: I am poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax; it is melted within me.
controles.kjv: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.
controles.livre: Eu me derramei como água, e todos os meus ossos se soltaram uns dos outros; meu coração é como cera, e se derreteu por entre meus órgãos.

versos.hebraico: יָ֘בֵ֤שׁ כַּחֶ֨רֶשׂ׀ כֹּחִ֗י וּ֭לְשׁוֹנִי מֻדְבָּ֣ק מַלְקוֹחָ֑י וְֽלַעֲפַר־מָ֥וֶת תִּשְׁפְּתֵֽנִי׃

controles.web: My strength is dried up like a potsherd. My tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You have brought me into the dust of death.
controles.kjv: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaveth to my jaws; and thou hast brought me into the dust of death.
controles.livre: Minha força se secou como um caco de barro, e minha língua está grudada no céu da boca; e tu me pões no pó da morte;

versos.hebraico: כִּ֥י סְבָב֗וּנִי כְּלָ֫בִ֥ים עֲדַ֣ת מְ֭רֵעִים הִקִּיפ֑וּנִי כָּ֝אֲרִ֗י יָדַ֥י וְרַגְלָֽי׃

controles.web: For dogs have surrounded me. A company of evildoers have enclosed me. They have pierced my hands and feet.
controles.kjv: For dogs have compassed me: the assembly of the wicked have inclosed me: they pierced my hands and my feet.
controles.livre: Porque cães ficaram ao meu redor; uma multidão de malfeitores me cercou; perfuraram minhas mãos e meus pés.

versos.hebraico: אֲסַפֵּ֥ר כָּל־עַצְמוֹתָ֑י הֵ֥מָּה יַ֝בִּ֗יטוּ יִרְאוּ־בִֽי׃

controles.web: I can count all of my bones. They look and stare at me.
controles.kjv: I may tell all my bones: they look and stare upon me.
controles.livre: Eu poderia contar todos os meus ossos; eles estão me olhando, e prestando atenção em mim.

versos.hebraico: יְחַלְּק֣וּ בְגָדַ֣י לָהֶ֑ם וְעַל־לְ֝בוּשִׁ֗י יַפִּ֥ילוּ גוֹרָֽל׃

controles.web: They divide my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.
controles.kjv: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.
controles.livre: Eles repartem entre si minhas roupas; e sobre minha vestimenta eles lançam sortes.

versos.hebraico: וְאַתָּ֣ה יְ֭הוָה אַל־תִּרְחָ֑ק אֱ֝יָלוּתִ֗י לְעֶזְרָ֥תִי חֽוּשָׁה׃

controles.web: But don’t be far off, Yahweh. You are my help: hurry to help me.
controles.kjv: But be not thou far from me, O Lord: O my strength, haste thee to help me.
controles.livre: Porém tu, SENHOR, não fiques longe; força minha, apressa-te para me socorrer.

versos.hebraico: הַצִּ֣ילָה מֵחֶ֣רֶב נַפְשִׁ֑י מִיַּד־כֶּ֝֗לֶב יְחִידָתִֽי׃

controles.web: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dog.
controles.kjv: Deliver my soul from the sword; my darling from the power of the dog.
controles.livre: Livra minha alma da espada; e minha vida da violência do cão.

versos.hebraico: ה֭וֹשִׁיעֵנִי מִפִּ֣י אַרְיֵ֑ה וּמִקַּרְנֵ֖י רֵמִ֣ים עֲנִיתָֽנִי׃

controles.web: Save me from the lion’s mouth! Yes, from the horns of the wild oxen, you have answered me.
controles.kjv: Save me from the lion’s mouth: for thou hast heard me from the horns of the unicorns.
controles.livre: Salva-me da boca do leão; e responde-me dos chifres dos touros selvagens.

versos.hebraico: אֲסַפְּרָ֣ה שִׁמְךָ֣ לְאֶחָ֑י בְּת֖וֹךְ קָהָ֣ל אֲהַלְלֶֽךָּ׃

controles.web: I will declare your name to my brothers. In the midst of the assembly, I will praise you.
controles.kjv: I will declare thy name unto my brethren: in the midst of the congregation will I praise thee.
controles.livre: Então eu contarei teu nome a meus irmãos; no meio da congregação eu te louvarei.

versos.hebraico: יִרְאֵ֤י יְהוָ֨ה׀ הַֽלְל֗וּהוּ כָּל־זֶ֣רַע יַעֲקֹ֣ב כַּבְּד֑וּהוּ וְג֥וּרוּ מִ֝מֶּ֗נּוּ כָּל־זֶ֥רַע יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: You who fear Yahweh, praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, glorify him! Stand in awe of him, all you descendants of Israel!
controles.kjv: Ye that fear the Lord, praise him; all ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; and fear him, all ye the seed of Israel.
controles.livre: Vós que temeis ao SENHOR, louvai a ele! E vós, de toda a semente de Jacó, glorificai a ele! Prestai culto a ele, vós de toda a semente de Israel.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י לֹֽא־בָזָ֨ה וְלֹ֪א שִׁקַּ֡ץ עֱנ֬וּת עָנִ֗י וְלֹא־הִסְתִּ֣יר פָּנָ֣יו מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וּֽבְשַׁוְּע֖וֹ אֵלָ֣יו שָׁמֵֽעַ׃

controles.web: For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, Neither has he hidden his face from him; but when he cried to him, he heard.
controles.kjv: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; neither hath he hid his face from him; but when he cried unto him, he heard.
controles.livre: Porque ele não desprezou nem abominou a aflição do aflito, nem escondeu seu rosto dele; mas sim, quando o aflito clamou, ele o ouviu.

versos.hebraico: מֵ֥אִתְּךָ֗ תְֽהִלָּ֫תִ֥י בְּקָהָ֥ל רָ֑ב נְדָרַ֥י אֲ֝שַׁלֵּ֗ם נֶ֣גֶד יְרֵאָֽיו׃

controles.web: Of you comes my praise in the great assembly. I will pay my vows before those who fear him.
controles.kjv: My praise shall be of thee in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.
controles.livre: Meu louvor será para ti na grande congregação; eu pagarei meus juramentos perante os que o temem.

versos.hebraico: יֹאכְל֬וּ עֲנָוִ֨ים׀ וְיִשְׂבָּ֗עוּ יְהַֽלְל֣וּ יְ֭הוָה דֹּ֣רְשָׁ֑יו יְחִ֖י לְבַבְכֶ֣ם לָעַֽד׃

controles.web: The humble shall eat and be satisfied. They shall praise Yahweh who seek after him. Let your hearts live forever.
controles.kjv: The meek shall eat and be satisfied: they shall praise the Lord that seek him: your heart shall live for ever.
controles.livre: Os humilhados comerão, e ficarão fartos; louvarão ao SENHOR aqueles que o buscam; vosso coração viverá para sempre.

versos.hebraico: יִזְכְּר֤וּ׀ וְיָשֻׁ֣בוּ אֶל־יְ֭הוָה כָּל־אַפְסֵי־אָ֑רֶץ וְיִֽשְׁתַּחֲו֥וּ לְ֝פָנֶ֗יךָ כָּֽל־מִשְׁפְּח֥וֹת גּוֹיִֽם׃

controles.web: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to Yahweh. All the relatives of the nations shall worship before you.
controles.kjv: All the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto the Lord: and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee.
controles.livre: Todos os extremos da terra se lembrarão disso , e se converterão ao SENHOR; e todas as gerações das nações adorarão diante de ti.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י לַ֭יהוָה הַמְּלוּכָ֑ה וּ֝מֹשֵׁ֗ל בַּגּוֹיִֽם׃

controles.web: For the kingdom is Yahweh’s. He is the ruler over the nations.
controles.kjv: For the kingdom is the Lord’s: and he is the governor among the nations.
controles.livre: Porque o reino pertence ao SENHOR; e ele governa sobre as nações.

versos.hebraico: אָכְל֬וּ וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוּ֨וּ׀ כָּֽל־דִּשְׁנֵי־אֶ֗רֶץ לְפָנָ֣יו יִ֭כְרְעוּ כָּל־יוֹרְדֵ֣י עָפָ֑ר וְ֝נַפְשׁ֗וֹ לֹ֣א חִיָּֽה׃

controles.web: All the rich ones of the earth shall eat and worship. All those who go down to the dust shall bow before him, even he who can’t keep his soul alive.
controles.kjv: All they that be fat upon earth shall eat and worship: all they that go down to the dust shall bow before him: and none can keep alive his own soul.
controles.livre: Todos os ricos da terra comerão e adorarão, e perante o rosto dele se prostrarão todos os que descem ao pó, e que não podem manter viva sua alma.

versos.hebraico: זֶ֥רַע יַֽעַבְדֶ֑נּוּ יְסֻפַּ֖ר לַֽאדֹנָ֣י לַדּֽוֹר׃

controles.web: Posterity shall serve him. Future generations shall be told about the Lord.
controles.kjv: A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to the Lord for a generation.
controles.livre: A descendência o servirá; ela será contada ao Senhor, para a geração seguinte .

versos.hebraico: יָ֭בֹאוּ וְיַגִּ֣ידוּ צִדְקָת֑וֹ לְעַ֥ם נ֝וֹלָ֗ד כִּ֣י עָשָֽׂה׃

controles.web: They shall come and shall declare his righteousness to a people that shall be born, for he has done it.
controles.kjv: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done this.
controles.livre: Chegarão, e anunciarão a justiça dele ao povo que nascer, porque ele assim fez.
